name: Zenith Summoner's Legacy
name_jp: 究極残されし召喚士の力
effects:
Seven single-target Lightning/Holy/NE summon magical attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking] or [Attach Holy 2 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Garnet Trance], [Zenith Mode] & Zenith Mode: Garnet (Lightning/Holy) to user
Ultimate Spirit Mode: En-Lightning/Holy Damage +20% & Magic Casting Speed x1.1
Ultimate Dexterity Mode: Dualcast Lightning/Holy, Higher Multiplier & Zero Hone Cost to Hero Ability; Divine Guardian+ II: 6 hits
Ultimate Vitality Mode: +1500 max HP & Astra to user
